Skip set widened, same file and same predicate (`refusedAfterTheCredential` in `auth-manager-after-hook.ts`): the dev's out-of-scope finding 1 (report 6712725182) measured two more refusals that come AFTER the password verified on `/sign-in/email` and still count toward the lockout, on the `AuthManager.handleRequest` harness (better-auth 1.7.12, threshold 3): `403 BANNED_USER` (admin plugin on; three correct-password sign-ins of a banned account locked it, and after the ban was lifted the next correct sign-in answered `ACCOUNT_LOCKED`) and `403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (`requireEmailVerification`; one correct-password attempt took the count 2 → 3 and locked). The card's Expected is the principle — only a refused credential counts — so both join `SESSION_SCOPING_REFUSAL.code` in this PR rather than on a second card. Name each code by an exported constant where one exists; where the vendor exports none, one module-level constant with a comment naming its vendor source, never an inline literal. Pins on the same harness: each refusal leaves the count unchanged; a wrong password still counts. Changeset and PR body name all three. `Clause-②: no` and the rest of the claim stand. The MFA hold (`200 twoFactorRedirect`, clears the count) stays as is, as the dev judged.
